_what: META (Meta Platforms) valuation as of 2026-10-02: Damodaran's Ginzu FCFF model and the Feb-2024 Meta story, base year rolled to the twelve months ended 2026-06-30, reinvestment re-anchored on the AI capital spending in the filings

_sources.ebit: FILING: TTM income from operations = 83,276 + 41,647 - 37,997 (includes $2.4bn of Q2-2026 legal charges)
_sources.book_debt: FILING: long-term debt 83,664 + operating lease liabilities 2,425 + 26,229 = 112,318 at 2026-06-30 (finance lease liabilities sit in other liabilities and are not added)
_sources.cash: FILING: cash and cash equivalents 15,462 + marketable securities 74,798 at 2026-06-30 (restricted cash excluded)
_sources.non_operating_assets: FILING: non-marketable equity investments 30,157 at 2026-06-30 (cross holdings)
_sources.effective_tax_rate: FILING/GUIDANCE: 16%, the midpoint of the company's 15-17% outlook for the rest of 2026 (Q2-2026 rate 15.5%); the TTM rate is distorted by a $15.93bn Q3-2025 charge and an $8.03bn Q1-2026 benefit
_sources.growth_next_year: JUDGMENT anchored on consensus: next-12-month revenue ~$281bn = consensus 2026 $254.2bn less actual H1 $117.1bn, plus ~47% of consensus 2027 $306.4bn (S&P Global via StockAnalysis, 2026-10-02); company guides Q3-2026 revenue to $61-64bn (8-K 2026-07-29)
_sources.margin_next_year: JUDGMENT: 2026 expense guidance ($165-169bn) against ~$254bn of revenue is a ~34% GAAP margin; capitalizing R&D adds ~12 points (current R&D-adjusted margin 49.1%)
_sources.growth_years_2_5: DAMODARAN Feb-2024 Meta story: 12% a year (Seven Samurai post). Breakeven vs price: 10.9%
_sources.target_margin: DAMODARAN Feb-2024 Meta story: 40% target operating margin by year 5
_sources.sales_to_capital_1_5: JUDGMENT anchored on filings: TTM reinvestment ~$94.8bn (capex 89,325 + finance-lease principal 3,104 - depreciation 22,729 + net R&D capitalization 25,058) bought $49.4bn of extra revenue = 0.52; current revenue / invested capital 0.56; 2026 capex guided to $130-145bn. Damodaran's Feb-2024 input was 1.5
_sources.sales_to_capital_6_10: DAMODARAN Meta2024 input (1.5): efficiency returns once the AI build-out matures
_sources.riskfree_rate: MARKET: US 10-year Treasury par yield 5.28% on 2026-10-02 (home.treasury.gov daily yield curve)
_sources.mature_erp: DAMODARAN July 2026 country-risk update: mature market ERP 4.20% (country_risk.py, ctrypremJuly26.xlsx)
_sources.cost_of_capital: DAMODARAN METHOD and choice (Meta2024 sheet: industry-average approach, single business US Advertising): industry cost of capital 7.81% (Damodaran data, Jan 2026) + (riskfree 5.28% - 4.58% in the data) = 8.51%
_sources.terminal_roic: DAMODARAN Meta2024 override (15%: lasting advantages of the ad platforms)

scenarios.name: Growth yrs 2-5 at 15% (AI lifts ad pricing)
Target margin 35% (AI depreciation and legal costs)
Target margin 45% (AI pays off in efficiency)
Terminal ROIC = cost of capital (Ginzu default)
Next-year revenue = 4 x Q3 guidance midpoint ($250bn)

notes: Story: Damodaran's Feb-2024 Meta story (12% revenue growth, 40% target margin, 15% terminal ROIC, industry-average cost of capital) is kept; the base year and the reinvestment efficiency are updated because AI capital spending ($130-145bn guided for 2026) has cut sales-to-capital to about 0.5.
Damodaran's May-2026 post flags Meta's AI spending as the key test of Zuckerberg's big bets, with shareholders reduced to bystanders by the dual-class structure.
Analyst consensus figures (revenue, price target) are third-party data from S&P Global via StockAnalysis, shown for reference.
